title: Time-Thieving Monocle
text: A slain Time-Thief Mosquito has a 5% chance to drop this monocle, increased by 5 percentage points per level of Looting. Mosquitoes dissolving after feeding leave no drops.
Using the monocle consumes it and grants Time Thief and Amon’s Gaze. You cannot use it while you already have a talent or curse.
